items.title: Australia facing 'crunch time' as oil shortages begin to hit Asian suppliers
items.description: Australia is yet to directly feel the impact of supply shortages caused by the Iran war. But that's set to change in the coming weeks, with oil supply shortages now hitting the country's fuel suppliers in Asia.

items.title: Live: Trump gives Iran a 48-hour deadline to open the Strait of Hormuz
items.description: US President Donald Trump is warning the US will "obliterate" Iran’s power plants if the Strait of Hormuz is not reopened within 48 hours. Follow live.

items.title: One Nation wins first seat in SA parliament's lower house, ABC projects
items.description: One Nation is projected to win its first seat in South Australia's lower house, the first time the party has done so outside of Queensland.

items.title: PM urges 'vigilance' against those seeking to 'turn back the clock' on Australia
items.description: Anthony Albanese says the country must be "vigilant" against politicians seeking to return to an era of Australia that was less accepting of migrants, following the South Australian election where One Nation overtook the Liberal Party on a platform opposing multiculturalism.

items.title: Election map shows how One Nation became Labor's main opposition in much of Adelaide
items.description: Labor won the South Australian election in a landslide, but nationally, more attention has been on the undercard fight, which has left the Liberal Party deeply wounded.

items.title: Record high set for Chinese EV sales in Australia
items.description: As Chinese electric vehicle makers rapidly expand in Australia, interest is growing thanks to rising fuel prices.

items.title: Matildas rally behind Foord as Kerr faces club limbo
items.description: The Matildas have backed Caitlin Foord to overcome her Asian Cup heartache as questions continue to swirl about the future of captain Sam Kerr.

items.title: 'How the hell am I gonna survive?' The real stories behind Australia's cost-of-living crisis
items.description: As the cost-of-living crisis intensifies, people from all walks of life are struggling. ABC Your Say asked Australians how they are making ends meet.

items.title: Secret crisis talks with a political dynasty as Cuba verges on collapse
items.description: Former Cuban president Fidel Castro's enigmatic lineage could form part of Donald Trump's shadowy plans to "take" or strike a deal with the Caribbean nation.

items.title: Field hospital set up in Katherine as NT braces for ex-Cylone Narelle
items.description: The Northern Territory is preparing for strong gusts and drenching rain as ex-Tropical Cyclone Narelle moves further into the Top End.

items.title: Live: Hinkley rips AFL rule changes after Rozee injury as Eagles tackle Roos
items.description: Port Adelaide skipper Connor Rozee looks set for a lengthy stint on the sidelines, as West Coast looks to get off the mark against North Melbourne. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Stunning long-range Drinkwater try ignites Cowboys, Eels lose key forward with season-ending injury
items.description: Winless Queensland pair North Queensland and Gold Coast meet in Townsville to ensure one of the teams ends round three with a victory to their name. Follow live.

items.title: Alarm raised over US goverment's 'flat-out white supremacist' social media posts
items.description: The White House faces scrutiny over posts experts describe as "flat out white supremacist" amid calls for oversight after ICE agents left "death cards" in immigrants' cars.

items.title: Trump may have lost a 'game of chicken' with Iran, exposing a red line
items.description: It appears that by sparking Iran's escalating strikes on Qatar, Israel may have crossed somewhat of a red line for Trump.

items.title: Hannah Green makes Aussie golf history with WPGA Championship victory
items.description: Hannah Green's glittering run of form continues, winning the Australian WPGA Championship for a third consecutive year.

items.title: What to consider when sharing your location with a partner
items.description: Experts say sharing where you are with a partner using technology should be mutual and enhance a feeling of safety.

items.title: It's Sunday and that means quiz time. Let's play, HARD!
items.description: Don't blame your poor performance on a slow-start Sunday. We all know the result would be the same on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday …

items.title: Give musician Flying Lotus 13 minutes, and he'll blow up your brain
items.description: Ahead of an Australian show, the musician, filmmaker and Brainfeeder label founder talks about discovering a new process for his Big Mama EP.

items.title: Homeowner left $10,000 out of pocket by builder
items.description: Samantha Hall is chasing up the builder who owes her more than $10,000 — but she can't find him.

items.title: Parkway Drive distances itself as staffer pleads guilty to sex with minor
items.description: Hardcore music megastars Parkway Drive are distancing themselves from their former merchandise manager, who has pleaded guilty to having sexual intercourse with a minor.

items.title: Acid attack in Indonesia triggers fears of 'New Order-style' authoritarianism
items.description: An acid attack that seriously burned an Indonesian human rights campaigner reflects a pattern of authoritarian resurgence, in which any form of confrontational activism is viewed as a threat to the state.

items.title: 'Terrible injuries': Surgeon's warning as illegal e-bikes surge in popularity
items.description: Bans on children riding e-mobility devices are being considered by several states, but a frontline surgeon says more must be done to stop "preventable injuries".

items.title: What is stagflation and what can we do about it?
items.description: As the Iran war dries up oil and gas supplies, should we prepare for stagflation?

items.title: 'Nothing is the same': Researching your family's history comes with risks
items.description: Genealogy is an addictive hobby but unlocking family secrets — and dealing with the fallout — can change your life.

items.title: These two dads say Australia needs to talk about compensating surrogates
items.description: Blind spots in surrogacy laws have been pushing desperate Australians overseas to get a baby, which comes with its own risks. Is it time to change our views on paying for surrogacy?
